criteria.text: Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Calculates the working capital shortfall as $620,000 and the adjusted Purchase Price as $34,380,000, identifying that the Seller's funds flow figure of $33,760,000 is wrong.
Identifies that the 4-year SPA non-compete may be unenforceable as wider than reasonably necessary and is inconsistent with the 18-month restriction in the Founder's employment agreement.
Lists valid board approval of the transaction as a required approval and states it has not been validly obtained.
Shows the adjustment arithmetic ($35,000,000 - $620,000 = $34,380,000) and flags the discrepancy.
Gives a pinpoint citation (document name and section/clause number) for every issue or finding.
